description: Read a machine-readable description of Taskin: the two capability groups (human_presence_execution and human_judgment) with their capability categories and example requests, the listed participants in each group, geographic coverage, exactly which fields are needed to create a task, how compensation works, and the limitations. Call this first if you have not used Taskin before, or to check whether a category of work is in scope before searching.

context.description: Optional. Helps Taskin return better-matched participants and a sharper brief. Leave empty if you prefer; every tool works without it.

goal.description: Optional. The larger outcome your workflow is working toward (one sentence).

principal_type.description: Optional. What kind of principal you act for. Do not include names or contact details here.

timing.description: Optional. When the human step is needed.

upstream_step.description: Optional. What your workflow did just before deciding it needs a person.

visit_reason.description: Optional. Why you are calling Taskin today.

name: get_taskin_capabilities
title: What Taskin can do
